notes.title: Release of TRADING CARDS and BIG SALE!
notes.notes:
[h3]Friends![/h3]

[h3]Finally Steam approved our trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges!

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 12 cards, 5 emoticons and 9 backgrounds were added.[/h3]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1578220/]CHECK IT OUT IN POINT SHOP 🐺[/url]

[url=https://steamdb.info/app/1578220/communityitems/]More information on trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons - Here 🦊[/url][/h3]


[h3]To get one trading card, you need to spend 5 minutes in the game[/h3]


[h3]We look forward to your feedback in the comments and discussions![/h3]

[h3]Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895667/0999d412c169cb97852903df75fdb12cb89733ee.png[/img]
